latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Cold Email Writer skill.

- Generates complete cold prospecting emails (subject line, body, annotated structure, send-time suggestion) using the AMMO and Hook-Relate-Bridge-Ask frameworks from "Fanatical Prospecting."
- Applies deliverability and spam pre-checks to maximize reply rates and avoid common cold email pitfalls.
- Enforces best practices: prospect-focused subject under 50 characters, no attachments/images, one-to-one send, action-oriented ask.
- Outputs a send-ready .md draft that passes the Three Cardinal Rules (Delivered, Opened, Converted).
- Requires user-provided prospect context, value proposition, and desired email objective.
